properties.title: Treatment-aware Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Longitudinal MRI Generation and Diffuse Glioma Growth Prediction

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Retrospective evaluation of a treatment-aware diffusion model that generates future multi-parametric MRI and tumor masks, with a five-patient local test set and an external MRI-only set.
properties.independent_study_claim: single-institution development; external set evaluated for MRI generation only

properties.description: 2D U-Net diffusion network with treatment-day embeddings, source MRI concatenation, a shared segmentation branch and repeated sampling for uncertainty.
properties.world_model_status: conditional generative forecaster; no carried state

properties.algorithm: Treatment-aware Diffusion (TaDiff) with joint segmentation and DF weighting

properties.population: patients with diffuse high-grade glioma after surgery receiving chemoradiation and temozolomide
properties.decision: re-evaluating treatment plan and scan timing is suggested in the discussion; no deployed use

properties.description: Five held-out local patients (48 scans, 3,352 slices) from a 23-patient high-grade glioma dataset; the split was manual
LUMIERE, 37 patients and 132 exams from Inselspital Bern, no manual tumor masks, 8,976 test slices
Held-out patients, local and external, with per-patient and per-treatment-day breakdowns; no cross-validation

relation_assertions.rationale: Forecasts future MRI and tumor masks from prior scans and a specified treatment-day, with no action selection and no effect estimand. Treatment conditioning is real but alternative treatments are not compared, so BP_COMPARE and BP_EFFECT are not met.
Reviewer mapping: treatment and day conditioning is implemented as a learned input. M3 and M7 are not mapped because no state service or causal layer exists.
Reviewer mapping: a learned conditional diffusion dynamics adapter.

capability_assessments.rationale: Core world-model identity (V11) is not met because state.persistent is absent (history is three raw 2D source images concatenated in pixel space with no latent or carried state) and dynamics.temporal is partial. Consequently, formal capability is downgraded from L1 to not_world_model (evaluated supporting component), while preserving that predicted next scans and tumor masks are scored against real follow-ups on five held-out local patients and LUMIERE external MRIs (rollout.one_step_evaluated present at evaluation). Alternative-treatment comparison is also not validated because CRT and TMZ are collinear with treatment day.

legacy_cells.B: Treatment-aware Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Longitudinal MRI Generation and Diffuse Glioma Growth Prediction
legacy_cells.C: Liu, Qinghui, Fuster-Garcia, Elies, Hovden, Ivar Thokle, MacIntosh, Bradley J, Grødem, Edvard, Brandal, Petter, et al.
legacy_cells.S: Given sequential MRI scans and treatment/day history, what future MRI and tumor mask are predicted at a specified future treatment and day?
legacy_cells.T: Local cohort: 23 histology-confirmed diffuse high-grade glioma patients (18 training, 5 test); external LUMIERE cohort: 37 high-grade glioma patients.
legacy_cells.AI: Sequential multi-parametric MRI (T1-weighted, contrast-enhanced T1, FLAIR); treatment category (CRT or TMZ); treatment day
legacy_cells.AJ: 2D U-Net-like encoder–decoder with skip connections; sinusoidal diffusion-timestep embedding and MLP treatment/day embeddings
legacy_cells.AM: MRI source scans are concatenated with the noisy target image; treatment and day are separately embedded, summed for each pair, and injected into the U-Net (with source-to-target embedding differences also used).
legacy_cells.BD: Treatment category (CRT or TMZ) and treatment day; dose, route, and duration are not specified as encoded attributes.
legacy_cells.BS: Future multi-parametric MRI and tumor masks for source and future MRI sessions; sampled predictions also yield standard-deviation uncertainty maps.
legacy_cells.BT: Joint tumor-segmentation output for source and future images
legacy_cells.BV: Noise-prediction MSE plus weighted joint Dice segmentation loss for source and future tumor masks (λ = 0.01); dilated tumor-region weighting is applied.
legacy_cells.CA: 350 GPU hours on one Nvidia V100 32GB GPU
legacy_cells.CD: 24+ months between input and target scans (reported interval range)
legacy_cells.CE: Reported as most reliable within a 4-month window (mean Dice 0.75 ± 0.12).
legacy_cells.CG: Five stochastic samplings per conditioning input; pixel-wise standard deviation used for uncertainty maps.
legacy_cells.DQ: Local: 23 patients and 225 MRI exams (18 training patients/177 scans; 5 test patients/48 scans). External LUMIERE: 37 patients and 132 MRI exams.
legacy_cells.DX: Local test: future tumor prediction DSC 0.719 ± 0.13; source segmentation DSC 0.849 ± 0.09; MRI generation SSIM 0.919 ± 0.03, PSNR 27.966 ± 1.20, MSE 0.174 ± 0.05.
legacy_cells.EI: Against baseline-1 without treatment-aware input: SSIM 0.882 and future-tumor DSC 0.556 versus TaDiff 0.919 and 0.719. Against baseline-2 without joint learning/DF-weighting: SSIM 0.870 and DSC 0.541 versus TaDiff 0.919 and 0.719.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablated treatment-aware conditioning (baseline without treatment input) and joint-task learning / DF-weighting components.
legacy_cells.EL: Accuracy deteriorated with longer input–target gaps (DSC 0.85 to 0.46 at 0.5 to 24+ months). Poor predictions/outliers occurred for a patient undergoing second surgery and a patient with secondary glioblastoma, which were outside or rare in the training distribution.
legacy_cells.FL: Three source 2D multiparametric MRI scans and treatment/day inputs are fed to a treatment-aware U-Net diffusion network; shared denoising/segmentation components predict a future MRI and source/future tumor masks. Multiple stochastic samples provide uncertainty maps. No planner is implemented.
legacy_cells.FM: The authors introduce TaDiff, a treatment/day-conditioned diffusion model jointly generating future multiparametric MRI and tumor masks, with dilated longitudinal tumor-fusion weighting and stochastic uncertainty estimation.
legacy_cells.FN: Local test averages: future tumor DSC 0.719 ± 0.13; MRI SSIM 0.919 ± 0.03, PSNR 27.966 ± 1.20, MSE 0.174 ± 0.05. External MRI generation: SSIM 0.848, PSNR 27.51, MSE 0.242; tumor masks could not be quantitatively evaluated externally because annotations were unavailable.
legacy_cells.FO: The authors report limited patient/sample diversity and a five-patient local test set, slow/high-compute diffusion sampling, poor handling of rare secondary glioblastoma and second-surgery cases, and a need for larger, more diverse, multisite validation before clinical utility is established.
legacy_cells.FP: Collect and annotate more data, include additional tumor types and interventions (including second surgery), assess larger multisite cohorts, investigate faster diffusion sampling (e.g. DPM-Solver), explore Bayesian uncertainty, and integrate computational tumor models.
legacy_cells.FQ: Earlier glioma growth models were described as using image data alone, ignoring treatment effects, and lacking future MRI generation and associated uncertainty maps.
legacy_cells.FR: Treatment conditioning demonstrates predictive association, not identified causal effects of alternative regimens; no causal method/assumptions or planner/decision-quality evaluation is reported. Clinical benefit is unproven; external validation assessed MRI generation only because tumor masks were unannotated, and the local test had five patients.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pages 1–13: title/abstract, introduction, preliminaries, methods and architecture, dataset/metrics, training details, local and external results (Tables I–V and figures), discussion, limitations/future work, and conclusion. Page 14 references were inspected; they were not used as evidence. The supplied full-text stream contained all 14 pages. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Corrected prefilled year 2023 to 2025 because the PDF version read is arXiv v5 dated 22 Jan 2025 and carries a 2025 IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging header. Treatment conditioning supports L2 prediction only, not causal identification or counterfactual treatment effects; the paper reports no planner or decision-quality evaluation. External cohort tumor-mask metrics were unavailable because annotations were absent. Table text extraction has some alignment distortion (particularly Table II); only clearly legible reported values were used, without reconstructing ambiguous table entries. Evidence QA: 15/72 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (20.8%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Schema normalization (source details retained): CC normalized to 'One-step only'; source detail: One-step only: the three most recent historical MRIs are used to predict the nearest future frame; no feedback rollout is reported. | CT normalized to 'Associational action-conditioning'; source detail: Associational action-conditioning; treatment is an input, with no stated causal identification strategy or assumptions. Compounding-error evidence (CF): Yes — reported DSC declines from 0.85 to 0.46 as the input–target interval increases from 0.5 to 24+ months; uncertainty standard deviation widens from 0.09 to 0.32. limitations: All 14 PDF pages were read as extracted text in the original review. The targeted 2026-11-22 review read full bibliography entries on pp. 13–14 and directly verified Table I on p. 8, including task headers, averages and patient footnotes. Per-patient values are intentionally selectively transcribed; cited full studies remain unretrieved. Earlier figure/image checks remain attributed to their original reviews.
No code was found or inspected.
All performance results come from five local test patients and an external set with no masks, so differences between models are not statistically supported.
Core-model status and the L2 to L1 change are reviewer judgements.
Legacy cells were read from the root workbook row (read only). Unlisted columns remain imported-only. Saved API drafts for B023 were not opened.
Schema validity and quote occurrence do not establish semantic correctness. One reviewer pass; no independent human review.
notes: Treatment-aware diffusion model that generates future multi-parametric MRI and tumor masks from three prior scans and a treatment-day. L1 supported by held-out next-scan prediction. L2 not adopted because alternative treatments are not compared and treatment is not separated from day. No carried state, so treated as supporting component. Source points: five test patients, manual split, abstract language about different treatment plans without alternative-treatment evidence, unevaluated uncertainty.
